question: How many countries have higher average generiosity over years compared to the world' average?
query: To determine how many countries have higher average generosity compared to the world average, you can use the following SQL query: ```sql WITH global_avg AS (SELECT avg(generosity) FROM world_happiness_report) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_name) as num_countries FROM ( SELECT country_name, avg(generosity) as current_avg FROM world_happiness_report GROUP BY country_name ) subquery WHERE subquery.current_avg > global_avg.global_avg; ``` This query first calculates the global average of generosity and then computes each country's average.
